hero.title: Invoicing software that bills every tracked hour

sections.1.heading: Invoices from the hours you tracked
sections.1.body:
Pick a client and a period. Paidlyo adds **every unbilled hour** at the right rate.

- Group by project, task or person
- Add a discount and tax

See [pricing](/pricing) for what it costs.
sections.2.heading: Know who still owes you
sections.2.body:
Record payments and see what is outstanding by age.

| Age | Amount |
|---|---|
| 0–30 days | $4,200 |
| 31–60 days | $900 |
